verdict.rationale: Martin is itself an AI assistant that users delegate tasks to across calendar, email, Slack, reminders, to-dos, notes, shortcuts, and background tasks like briefings and email triage, with hands-on community reports confirming real usage (e.g., managing to-do lists, complex requests handled correctly). missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of reliability at scale, and resolution of open privacy/trust concerns raised by users.
